title: GTA 6 Update 1.002.002 Fixes the Bug That Ate Your Progress 💾 #Shorts
description:
GTA 6 just got its first post-launch patch. Update 1.002.002 started rolling out on November 23, 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Per the patch notes: fixed autosave not working correctly, players being unable to lose their Wanted Level, story/mission phone calls not triggering, weather not changing for extended periods, partners not handing over bags to sell to fences, the gym deadlift bar, and several crashes.

Sources: Push Square, ComicBook.com (patch notes via Vice.com).
Images: Rockstar Games (An Extended Look).
Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
